name: easeupmush
description: Ease Up Mush — browser games from Pompey for Pompey.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @easeupmush/site && GAME_BASE=/games/pompey-punch-up/ npm run build -w @easeupmush/pompey-punch-up && GAME_BASE=/games/pompeymon/ npm run build -w @easeupmush/pompeymon && GAME_BASE=/games/canoe-lake-cleanup/ npm run build -w @easeupmush/canoe-lake-cleanup && GAME_BASE=/games/bunsterstons/ npm run build -w @easeupmush/bunsterstons && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.site: npm run build && npm run preview
